text_en: I read something curious about this city's construction.
Did you know who the founders were? Jivan, a person known as Lady Sibunier and no less than Baydral himself.
From what I can tell, these three were the highest authority in Hafin and took in anyone who decided to stay under their protection.
Unfortunately, Lady Sibunier disappeared and Baydral, with time, became unhinged. He lost the respect of much of Hafin's inhabitants, turning miserable and sullen.
Maybe living that long isn't as great as it seems. What would have to go through his head for him to spend the rest of his days cooking up who knows what sort of plans...
